description: Land Title Settlement Department - Abhayapura, Lankapura D/S/Division Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120271 (24/0394)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
